title: Nivalis Nights
tropes: Alternative and/or future histories: evolution of humans on Earth or on other planets, post-humanism, transhumanism, mind uploading, ancient alien civilizations and cosmic ruins
Speculative technologies: brain-computer interfaces, bio-engineering, superintelligent computers, robots, ray guns, programmable matter, replicators, augmented reality, altered perception

Political and social systems: utopian, dystopian, post-apocalyptic, post-post-apocalyptic, post-scarcity societies, interplanetary colonial secession and autonomy movements, corporate governments, techno-religions and futuristic cults
